reason: Part 1 (render.6502 ~2071) is reached only by falling out of BPL each_part; restore_block's only caller is JSR restore_block in take_off (no label+N entries, columns is only JSR'd from these two sites and JMP'd from its own tails). C at the BPL is either (a) the header's SBC #0 of save_end_hi (no part present on any iteration: LDA/STA/LDY/LDA (v_ptr)/LDX/ORA/BEQ/DEX/BPL leave C alone), which is 1 since save_end_hi is an arena address (>= &30, put_on/compact write it from arena_top), or (b) the last JSR columns return followed by PLX/PLA/STA/PLA/STA/DEX/DEX (C-neutral): columns has a single RTS, after CMP rb_end+1 with BNE not taken, i.e. equal, so C = 1; every other tail (part_byte, compiled bank/HAZEL/kc_restore) JMPs back to columns. So SEC before SBC #4 is redundant on every path; A, C, N, Z, V after SBC #4 are identical, and STA v_ptr / LDA / SBC #0 / STA / JSR columns follow unchanged. No stack change; interrupts preserve P via RTI. Saves SEC: 2 cycles an execution, 1 byte (code after moves down a byte; branch page-crossing in columns is the machine lens's to check).
